title: F*** Stephen A. Smith, Warriors' DeMarcus Cousins Tells Scoop B Radio
htmlContent:
Earlier today Brandon "Scoop B" Robinson released a transcript of an interview with DeMarcus Cousins.  The interview covered a variety of different topics, which includes Stephen A Smith prediction that the Los Angeles Lakers will make the Western Conference Finals.

Cousins would respond with this statement:

"I don’t really care *laughs*.  Fuck this Stephen A. Smith, I don’t care about that" Cousins told Brandon "Scoop B" Robinson.

Robinson would follow up with Cousins by asking I guess my follow up question is, the Lakers: are you impressed with what they did in the offseason?

"They got the best player in the world.  Any team that’s able to do that- they’ve got a chance, Cousins said about LeBron James.

When Cousins was asked by "Scoop B" if the Lakers had a chance against the Warriors, Cousins replied:

We’ll see what happens when the ball goes up.

“I don’t really care. F*** this Stephen A. Smith, I don’t care about that.”

- Warriors’ DeMarcus Cousins’ response to me about Stephen A. Smith’s belief that LeBron James & Lakers could be in Western Conference Finals this year:#Warriors #Lakers pic.twitter.com/qQtEXUhnl4 — Brandon Robinson (@ScoopB) September 16, 2018

Warriors’ DeMarcus Cousins: “F**k” Stephen A. Smith

- Cousins’ response to me about Stephen A. Smith’s belief that LeBron James & Lakers could be in Western Conference Finals this year:#Warriors #Lakers #FirstTake #StephenASmith pic.twitter.com/tcXolFwH9r — Brandon Robinson (@ScoopB) September 17, 2018
